# Mardo

> Mardo is a free, open source browser and author for markdown, for macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone and iPad (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830193468). It asks servers for markdown, converts other pages, and saves changes back where the server allows.

## Pages

- [Mardo](https://mardo.henryvandenbroek.com/index.md): what Mardo does, how a page gets there, the AI tools and downloads
- [Where can I find markdown on the web?](https://mardo.henryvandenbroek.com/find-markdown.md): feeds, sites and directories that serve Markdown directly, and how to search for more
- [Privacy policy](https://mardo.henryvandenbroek.com/privacy.md): what Mardo stores, what it sends, and to whom

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/hbroek/mardo): the repository and README
- [Releases](https://github.com/hbroek/mardo/releases/latest): downloads for each system
